_comment: Early vote tracker settings. Party registration is not party vote: these are participation signals only. The routine reads this before its research step. Registration baselines carry their source and as-of date; refresh a baseline only from an official state election office (or a named voter-file vendor when the state publishes none), and update its as_of and source_url when you do.
